_why: One home for every version constraint in this suite. The templates and the canaries read this file rather than repeating a range, because a number written in two places is a number that will disagree with itself and no check will notice. tests/test_pins.py fails if any workflow hardcodes one.

redfish-service-validator.role: DMTF's own schema conformance suite. Adopted, not built.

redfish-protocol-validator.role: DMTF's own protocol conformance suite. Adopted, not built.

bmc-sensor-audit.role: The referee: declaration diff, liveness, attestation.

arbiter-engine.role: The invariant envelope the referee reasons with.

qa-orchestrator.why_unpinned: not on any index yet, so this tracks a branch. A branch is NOT a pin: the same pipeline definition can resolve to different code on two consecutive days, and nothing here would report a difference. Replace with a version range the day it is released.
qa-orchestrator.role: Injects faults, drives walks, compares verdicts.

cert-generator.why_unpinned: not on any index yet, so this tracks a branch. Same caveat as qa-orchestrator.
cert-generator.role: Renders the certificate and holds unit identity.
